text:
Maya: heads up - saw weird operator inbox entries during canary: multiple fallback events for same request_id, different signals. anyone else?
Ian: saw that too. suspect race where soft-defer and circuit-breaker both annotate.
Zach: can you paste example?
Maya: paste log snippet:
```
req=abc123 signal=latency fallback=soft-defer ts=1610000000
req=abc123 signal=upstream-err fallback=circuit-breaker ts=1610000001
```
Elena: yeah that's the race. two decisioners fire in 200ms window. inbox groups by request_id but then shows two rows.
Ian: inbox grouping needs dedupe rules. propose primary-signal priority order: upstream-err > latency > rate-limit
Zach: but for audit we need both events persisted; UI can surface primary and collapsible details.
Maya: agree. also telemetry sampling causing missing context - sometimes we don't have model_variant in trace.
Elena: solution: when decisioner emits fallback, include `trace_delta` payload linking to parent trace_id and `decision_reason` field.
Ian: we already have trace_id, but `decision_reason` free-text is messy. canonicalize as enums: `REASON_LATENCY`, `REASON_KV_MISS`, `REASON_MODEL_UNLOAD`, `REASON_BACKEND_5XX`
Zach: +1 enums. Add `actor` field: `policy`, `operator_override`, `automatic`
Maya: UI asks: what gets shown in operator inbox top line? human-friendly reason + severity icon + time + primary signal.
Elena: and add "replay" button that opens sim with the exact inputs. but need RBAC.
Ian: RBAC note: operators should be able to see trace but not customer PII. redact payload server-side before storing for inbox.
Zach: opsdensity: should we sample only 1/10 for verbose payloads? otherwise DB costs blow up.
Maya: prefer adaptive sampling: sample all new model rollouts or high-severity events, otherwise 5%
Elena: telemetry team needs counters emitted: fallback_count{reason,variant,tenant}, duplicate_followups
Ian: also surface a "why-did-you-fallback" API endpoint that returns sequence of decisions for a request_id.
Zach: API shape proposal: GET /v1/internal/fallbacks/{request_id} -> [{ts, reason, policy, evidence: [signal,...], linked_traces: [...] }]
Maya: consider retention: store full payloads for 30d, summary metrics for 365d
Elena: UI microcopy: "Primary fallback: Circuit-breaker (automatic) — see details" keep short.
Ian: action item: Elena to draft telemetry schema, Zach to mock API, Maya to update inbox UX mock, I'll open infra ticket for retention + RBAC.
Elena: I'll sketch schema today. ping @srebot when ready for retention approval.
srebot: noted — will review and flag storage concerns.
Maya: thanks. small follow-up: operator workflow when multiple fallbacks for same user — prefer grouping by request_id then by primary signal, show collapse count + "merged at Xms"
Zach: also add small timestamp delta to show order.
Maya: cool. closing — if anyone has concerns reply here; I'll start a short RFC.
